persona: Resort activities/recreation manager scheduling excursions and classes
title: manage bookings for resort activities like excursions, water sports, and classes so we don't overbook capacity
workflowSummary: Guests browse and book activities (diving excursions, cooking classes, kids' club sessions) through the platform. The AI tracks capacity limits, staff/equipment availability, and guest preferences in real time, and can send reminders or suggest alternatives if weather or capacity forces a change.
samplePrompt: "We have 12 spots left on tomorrow's snorkeling excursion and a storm forecast for the afternoon slot. Suggest how to reallocate guests between the morning and afternoon departures."
beginnerNote: most useful once your full activity catalog and capacity rules are set up in the system
pricingNote: Paid subscription, exact pricing not publicly listed - verify before publishing

persona: Spa director at a hotel or resort spa
title: schedule spa treatments so therapists and treatment rooms are booked efficiently without double-booking
workflowSummary: When a guest books a treatment, the system automatically assigns a qualified therapist and an available treatment room in the same step, preventing double-booking of either. AI also dynamically fills schedule gaps by offering open slots to guests on a waitlist.
samplePrompt: "We have a last-minute cancellation for a 2pm deep tissue massage. Check the waitlist and suggest who to offer the slot to first."
beginnerNote: configuring services, therapist skills, and room types takes initial setup
pricingNote: Paid, typically per-location subscription - verify before publishing

persona: GM or guest relations manager at an extended-stay or aparthotel property
title: encourage long-stay guests to extend or renew their reservation instead of checking out
workflowSummary: The tool watches for signals that a current long-stay guest might want to extend (approaching checkout with no clear next step, similar past extension patterns) and prompts staff or sends the guest a personalized extension offer, syncing any accepted extension back to the PMS folio automatically.
samplePrompt: "This guest has been here 3 weeks on a corporate rate with checkout in 4 days and no forwarding booking. Draft a short message offering to extend their stay."
beginnerNote: runs alongside your existing PMS rather than replacing it, but needs that connection first
pricingNote: Paid subscription, exact pricing not publicly listed - verify before publishing

persona: Owner/operator of an aparthotel or serviced-apartment building
title: communicate with long-stay apartment guests and handle their billing (weekly/monthly rates, mid-stay changes) without a front desk
workflowSummary: The platform sends tailored messaging across a guest's multi-week or multi-month stay (welcome notes, mid-stay check-ins, follow-ups) through a dedicated guest portal, while automatically handling flexible pricing and billing for weekly or monthly rates, since standard nightly-rate billing doesn't fit long stays well.
samplePrompt: "Draft a mid-stay check-in message for a guest who's 2 weeks into a 6-week corporate stay, checking if they need anything and mentioning our weekly housekeeping schedule."
beginnerNote: best suited to properties already renting by the week or month, not typical one-night stays
pricingNote: Paid subscription, exact pricing not publicly listed - verify before publishing

persona: Hostel owner/manager selling both dorm beds and private rooms
title: sell individual dorm beds across Hostelworld, Booking.com, and our own website without double-booking a bed
workflowSummary: Unlike hotel software that only tracks whole rooms, this PMS tracks each individual bed inside a shared dorm. When one bed in a 6-bed dorm sells on any channel, it's instantly removed from availability everywhere else, so mixed dorms, single-gender dorms, and private rooms can all be sold from one pooled inventory without overbooking.
samplePrompt: "We have a 6-bed female dorm with 2 beds already booked via Hostelworld. Show what's left to sell on our direct website and Booking.com."
beginnerNote: purpose-built for hostels, so bed-level setup is the default rather than a workaround
pricingNote: Paid, typically per-bed or per-property subscription - verify before publishing

persona: Operator of an unstaffed hostel, aparthotel, or boutique property
title: let guests unlock the door and check in themselves without any staff present
workflowSummary: Once a guest completes online check-in and ID verification, the platform automatically generates a time-limited access code or digital key for the property's smart lock and sends it to the guest, with the code expiring automatically at checkout so no manual key handoff or re-coding is needed.
samplePrompt: "A guest checking in tomorrow at 3pm needs remote access instructions. Draft the message explaining how to use the smart lock, including what to do if the code doesn't work."
beginnerNote: requires compatible smart lock hardware already installed on the property
pricingNote: Paid subscription, exact pricing not publicly listed - verify before publishing

persona: Catering/banquet manager producing event documents for the kitchen and floor staff
title: create the banquet event order (BEO) with menu, costing, and setup details for an upcoming event
workflowSummary: Once an event's details (date, headcount, room, food & beverage package) are entered, the system automatically generates a formatted BEO, pulling in menu items with descriptions, pricing, and portions from your catering database, and produces separate versions for the client, kitchen, and front-of-house so nothing has to be retyped.
samplePrompt: "Generate a kitchen-facing BEO for a 120-guest plated dinner this Saturday at 7pm, including our herb-crusted salmon package and standard bar service."
beginnerNote: most useful once your menu items, packages, and pricing are set up as reusable building blocks
pricingNote: Paid, bundled with a broader event management subscription - verify before publishing

persona: Operations manager at an all-inclusive resort
title: let guests pay for drinks, food, and activities on property without carrying cash or a room key
workflowSummary: Each guest gets an RFID wristband linked to their account at check-in, usable to tap and pay at any restaurant, bar, or activity kiosk on property. The platform tracks spend and access in real time, so operators can see guest spending patterns and manage tiered access (like premium lounges) from one dashboard.
samplePrompt: "Summarize this week's wristband spend by outlet (bars, restaurants, activities) and flag which locations are seeing the highest per-guest spend."
beginnerNote: requires wristband hardware and point-of-sale integration across every outlet on property
pricingNote: Paid, hardware plus a transaction-based or subscription fee - verify before publishing

persona: Owner/operator of short-term rental units or an aparthotel building
title: screen incoming guests and manage security deposits to prevent parties, fraud, or property damage
intentLabels: AI guest screening for short-term rentals
workflowSummary: Before a booking is confirmed, the AI screens the guest against risk signals (ID mismatch, booking patterns associated with parties or fraud, network intelligence across properties) and flags anything suspicious. It also automates collecting and releasing a security deposit or damage waiver tied to the reservation, without manual back-and-forth.
samplePrompt: "This guest just booked a 2-night stay for 8 people with a same-day check-in and no prior reviews. Should this booking be flagged for manual review before confirming?"
beginnerNote: most valuable at higher booking volume, where manual screening isn't practical
pricingNote: Paid subscription, exact pricing not publicly listed - verify before publishing

persona: Restaurant manager at a hotel's on-site restaurant
title: manage table reservations and the walk-in waitlist for our hotel restaurant without double-booking
workflowSummary: Guests book directly through your website, Google, or social channels instead of a marketplace that charges a fee per cover. The system manages seating and waitlist in real time, sends automated confirmations and reminders to cut no-shows, and builds a guest profile from dining history for repeat visits.
samplePrompt: "We have a 90-minute wait for a table of 4 tonight. Draft the waitlist text message we send guests, including the estimated wait and a way to hold their spot."
beginnerNote: initial setup of your floor plan, table types, and booking rules takes some configuration
pricingNote: Paid, tiered pricing without a per-cover fee on direct bookings - verify before publishing

persona: F&B manager handling in-room dining orders
title: let guests order room service from their phone instead of calling the front desk
workflowSummary: Guests scan a QR code in their room to browse a digital, daypart-specific menu and place an order, which routes straight to the right kitchen station (hot, cold, bar) and posts the charge to their room folio automatically, cutting down on phone-order errors and front desk call volume.
samplePrompt: "Write a short in-room card message inviting guests to scan a QR code to order breakfast delivered by 8am, with a note that orders can be charged to the room."
beginnerNote: QR-code ordering is simple for guests; kitchen routing setup is the main configuration step
pricingNote: From about $20/month plus a small per-order fee, per vendor's published pricing - verify before publishing

persona: Family resort or all-inclusive activities manager running a kids' club
title: manage sign-ups, age-appropriate scheduling, and check-in/check-out for our resort's kids' club
workflowSummary: Parents register children and browse age-appropriate sessions through a parent app, staff check kids in and out digitally (with allergy/emergency contact info attached to each child's profile), and the system tracks capacity per age group so sessions don't get overcrowded.
samplePrompt: "We have 3 open spots in tomorrow's 8-10 year old craft session and a waitlist of 5 families. Draft a message to the first family on the waitlist offering the spot."
beginnerNote: most useful once your program schedule, age groups, and staff ratios are set up
pricingNote: Paid subscription, exact hospitality pricing not publicly listed - verify before publishing

persona: General manager or owner-relations manager at a condo hotel, fractional, or timeshare resort
title: give timeshare or fractional owners a self-service portal to see their statements and book their weeks
workflowSummary: Each owner gets a branded, secure portal to view real-time account statements, submit reservation requests for their contracted weeks or points, and access documents, cutting down on the phone calls and emails owner-relations staff would otherwise handle manually.
samplePrompt: "Draft the welcome email we send a new fractional owner explaining how to log into their owner portal and submit their first reservation request."
beginnerNote: initial setup of ownership contracts, fee schedules, and statement templates takes time
pricingNote: Paid, enterprise-style pricing for resort/HOA operators - verify before publishing

persona: Pool/beach operations manager at a resort
title: let guests reserve a specific cabana, lounger, or daybed in advance instead of a first-come-first-served scramble
workflowSummary: Guests view an interactive map of the pool and beach layout and reserve a specific chair, daybed, or cabana for a chosen date and time slot, with real-time availability so two guests can't be assigned the same spot, and staff can see exactly where each guest is seated for service.
samplePrompt: "Summarize tomorrow's cabana bookings by time slot and flag any gaps where we could offer walk-up guests an available spot."
beginnerNote: requires an initial custom map of your pool/beach layout to be built by the vendor
pricingNote: Paid subscription, exact pricing not publicly listed - verify before publishing

persona: Executive chef or kitchen manager responsible for guest food safety
title: track allergens across our menu so kitchen staff don't accidentally serve someone something they're allergic to
workflowSummary: The AI logs every ingredient as it enters the kitchen and keeps allergen tags current across every menu item, even when a recipe or supplier changes. When an order comes in with a flagged allergy, it can alert staff about shared prep surfaces or equipment that could cause cross-contamination.
samplePrompt: "A guest ordered the Caesar salad and noted a shellfish allergy. Check whether any ingredient in this dish or its prep process could pose a cross-contamination risk."
beginnerNote: value depends on keeping your recipe and ingredient data current in the system
pricingNote: Paid, typically bundled with a broader restaurant POS subscription - verify before publishing

persona: F&B manager wanting to make dining feel safe and personal for guests with dietary needs
title: let guests filter our restaurant's menu by their own allergies and dietary preferences before they order
workflowSummary: Guests select their allergies and dietary preferences (vegan, gluten-free, kosher, etc.) on a digital menu, and the AI automatically filters out any items containing a flagged allergen or that don't match their preferences, so guests browse a menu that's already been narrowed down to what's safe and suitable for them.
samplePrompt: "Set up filter categories for our menu covering the 9 major allergens plus vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free, so guests can self-filter before ordering."
beginnerNote: requires your menu's full ingredient data to be entered accurately for the filtering to be trustworthy
pricingNote: Paid subscription, exact pricing not publicly listed - verify before publishing
